build.title: Walkthrough Studio: workspace engine (panes, layouts, dockable + floating toolbars) as a framework contract (Fable rebuild)

said.text: Fable was offered for new cross-app engines, Opus chosen). Lift the studio-local workspace (ui.ts: pane areas, layouts, floats; toolbars docked on any edge or floating, the command catalog + customizer; pointer DnD with the pop-up trash can) into framework/core + framework/react as an engine every app can use (asset types for workspace layouts and user toolbars?), with fixtures; then switch the studio onto it and remove its private copy. Android twin deferred (PORTING.md).

steps.text: Read the Opus build (apps/walkthrough-studio/src/studio: ui.ts, Workspace.tsx, dnd.tsx, commands.ts) and write a design note: what becomes framework contract, asset types or not.
Pure engine in framework/core/engines (workspace + toolbars: places, docking, catalog) with fixtures + check script.
React layer: WorkspaceHost, ToolbarDock, floating toolbar, pane tabs + splitters, DnD + trash can, customizer dialog.
Runtime + settings: saved per app, last save wins, search/app-menu hooks (panes, layouts, toolbars).
Switch Walkthrough Studio onto it, delete its private copy; tests + screenshots; differences report.
PORTING.md deferred Kotlin twin; docs; CLAUDE.md.
